title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1117 | 迷你月亮、红毛吼猴、龟速玩具车
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🌙 地球抓到了一颗行李箱大小的迷你小月亮，12月就要飞走啦！
🐒 亚马逊雨林发现了两种新猴子，红毛大胡子，叫声三里外都能听见！
🚗 两个从小一起长大的好朋友，开着玩具车以每小时两英里的速度横穿美国！

📖 Word of the day: orbit（轨道）

🎮 二选一：开玩具车去看大瀑布，还是让一颗迷你小月亮天天跟着你？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🌙 Earth caught a tiny mini-moon the size of a suitcase, and it flies away in December!
🐒 Two new monkey species were found in the Amazon rainforest, with red fur, big beards, and howls you can hear from miles away!
🚗 Two best friends since kindergarten are driving toy cars across America at just two miles an hour!

📖 Word of the day: orbit

🎮 Would you rather ride a toy car all the way to a giant waterfall, or have a tiny second moon follow you everywhere?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. orbit（轨道）
the path something takes around something else
例：The little moon travels in its orbit around Earth!（小月亮沿着轨道绕地球转！）

2. howl（嚎叫）
a long, loud cry, like a monkey or a wolf
例：The howler monkey can howl from three miles away!（吼猴的叫声三里外都能听见！）

3. suitcase（手提箱；行李箱）
a box with a handle for carrying clothes on a trip
例：The little moon is about the size of a suitcase!（小月亮大概有一个手提箱那么大！）

4. waterfall（瀑布）
water falling down from a high rock
例：Niagara Falls is a giant waterfall!（尼亚加拉大瀑布是一个巨大的瀑布！）
